'''Chapter 165''' is titled "Operation Utopia".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Covers|Color Cover]]: "Flavor of Sand".

A snapshot of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] in [[Arabasta]]. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] pose against the setting sun; [[Nami]] shows off a vial of perfume; [[Usopp]] works on the [[Art of Weather/Clima-Tact|Clima-Tact]] while [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] logs the day's events; and [[Sanji]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] begin an early supper.

==Short Summary==
Despite [[Koza]] not being in [[Yuba]], [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] and the crew did not give up on stopping the rebellion. But, they first allow themselves a good rest. Meanwhile, Baroque Works' top members meet together in [[Rain Dinners]]. They discover that their leader, Mr. 0, is no other than Crocodile. After the initial shock, Crocodile reveals to them his plan to become the ruler of Arabasta, thus creating their own utopia. The plans begin the next morning at 7 AM. Next morning, [[Toto]] gives [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] a precious barrel of oasis water he helped to recover the other night. The Straw Hats then depart for their next destination. But suddenly, Luffy decides to stop moving on.

==Long Summary==
Remembering when Mr. Toto left Yuba, Vivi offers him a tissue and promises to stop the rebellion, the crew then decides to stay the night while Mr. Toto, and Luffy continue to dig for water. Meanwhile, the top brass of [[Baroque Works]] meet up, but are awaiting for Mr. 0, suddenly Miss All Sunday shows up and reveals that they are in Rain Dinners, a casino owned by Crocodile. It is also revealed that the leader is Crocodile himself and that he has been there the whole time, which surprises all the members, he then explains his "Utopia" plan. The next day, the Straw Hats are preparing to leave Yuba, and Mr. Toto gives them some water for their journey, but Luffy suddenly decides to quit.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] learns that [[Koza]] is not in [[Yuba]].
*[[Toto]] gives [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] a barrel of water.
*The meeting of [[Baroque Works]]' [[Officer Agents]] occurs in [[Rain Dinners]], a casino in the Arabasta city of [[Rainbase]].
**The Officer Agents discover [[Crocodile]] is their leader, Mr. 0.
**Crocodile explains "[[Operation Utopia]]", hinting [[Poneglyph|something of importance]] tied to [[Pluton|military might]] is hidden in Arabasta.
**The Officer Agents are given their orders for Baroque Works' final mission to bring about Crocodile's objectives.
